properties.title: Europeans dare to believe Trump could deliver security for Ukraine
properties.description: BERLIN — The proposal from U.S. President Donald Trump’s negotiating team to give Ukraine a NATO-style collective defense guarantee has triggered an unusual new mindset among some of Kyiv’s allies in Europe: optimism. European officials close to the peace negotiations are cautiously hopeful that the offer could signal a shift in America’s position in Ukraine’s favor — even though they remain wary that the price Trump will demand for such a sweeping commitment could be too high.  After two weeks of shuttle diplomacy, Trump’s envoy and son-in-law Jared Kushner proposed the security guarantee at last week’s press conference in Berlin, claiming the U.S. president is “open” to such a “big deal” and the Russians are now “comfortable” with it too.  Neither is yet certain, and one

properties.title: CCTV footage shows object crashing and exploding near Poland-Ukraine border – video
properties.description: <p>A security camera has captured an explosion near the Poland-Ukraine border after an unknown object fell near a Polish village. Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone crashed in Poland during Russian air attacks on Ukraine, officials said. properties.title: Russian ship damaged by drone attack in Gulf of Finland, Helsinki and Moscow say
properties.description: A cargo ship sailing under the Russian flag was damaged by a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday morning, the defense ministry in Helsinki said . Finnish authorities said at a press conference Saturday afternoon that Ukraine carried out the attack in international waters, and that the ship then drifted into Finnish territorial waters in the Eastern Gulf of Finland, according to Yle . Authorities also said that the ship is known to have links with the Russian armed forces, but that it could not be confirmed whether military equipment was on board. Russian state-owned news agency Tass said the vessel was transporting “paints and coatings,” citing a single unnamed source . properties.title: Tusk: Russian cruise missile incursion into Poland seems ‘intentional’
properties.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Friday that Russian projectiles entering his country’s territory appeared to be part of an “intentional provocation” from Moscow, hours after U.S. President Donald Trump characterized earlier Russian incursions as happening by “mistake.” One object exploded, but no one was hurt and there was no damage, Tusk said at a press conference. The incursion occurred as Russia launched a massive missile and drone assault on Ukraine , killing at least five people and damaging three major bridges in Kyiv. “This doesn’t look like an accident,” Tusk said, adding that he was choosing his words carefully because the matter was serious. properties.title: Russian missiles and drone reportedly hit Poland during attacks on Ukraine
properties.description: <p>Polish PM calls strikes, which took place amid western military exercises, ‘an intentional provocation’ by Moscow</p><p>Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone are reported to have crashed in Poland during Russian air attacks on Ukraine that took place amid major western military exercises by allied countries.</p><p>Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said it was “one of the largest attacks” since the full-scale Russian invasion in 2022, with at least eight people killed and nearly 30 injured in Ukraine.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/20/russian-missiles-drone-poland-attacks-ukraine">Continue reading...</a>

properties.title: Russia hits 3 Kyiv bridges in major attack, while Poland reports airspace violation
properties.description: Russia launched a massive missile and drone attack on Ukraine overnight, killing at least five people and damaging three of Kyiv’s main bridges across the Dnipro River — while Poland reported a violation of its airspace. The strikes came hours after U.S. President Donald Trump called into a meeting of Ukraine’s European allies from Air Force One and said Russian President Vladimir Putin was serious about peace negotiations. In Kyiv, three people were killed and about 15 were injured,  Mayor Vitali Klitschko said . properties.title: Estonia has a plan for Russian occupation: Run its government from the cloud
properties.description: TALLINN — Imagine French General Charles de Gaulle, exiled in London during World War II, running his Free France government by logging into the cloud. Officials in Estonia are preparing for exactly such a scenario with a new strategy to boost doomsday resilience — hukukindlus in Estonian — that would allow the government’s digital services to be run entirely from abroad if its territory is occupied by a foreign enemy. The Baltic country of  1.3 million, which shares a 294-kilometer border with Russia, fears it is a prime target if Moscow were to invade a European Union country. Security services have already warned that Russia is waging a hybrid war on Europe, and Estonia has blamed Moscow for everything from cyberattacks to arson plots to cuts to undersea data cables .
